title: Patient Relations Circular — Multi-Service Courtesy on Kept Mobility Equipment Chairs
content:
# Multi-Service Courtesy — Kept Cash-Sale Mobility Equipment Chairs

**Circular.** On a Mobility Equipment chair sold for cash that the patient keeps, a multi-service courtesy is added to the price adjustment when the patient also holds Summit Ridge sleep-therapy or oxygen equipment: 20.00 when the patient's PAP Therapy Equipment record is rental active or the patient's Home Oxygen Therapy record is rental active; 10.00 when neither record is rental active and the patient's PAP Therapy Equipment record is patient owned or the patient's Home Oxygen Therapy record is payment cap reached; and nothing otherwise.

## Records read

The status of the patient's PAP Therapy Equipment record and the status of the patient's Home Oxygen Therapy record.

## Truth table

| PAP Therapy Equipment record | Home Oxygen Therapy record | Courtesy (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| rental active | any status, or none | 20.00 |
| any status, or none | rental active | 20.00 |
| patient owned | not rental active, or none | 10.00 |
| not rental active, or none | payment cap reached | 10.00 |
| any other status, or none | any other status, or none | nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

- A patient renting a CPAP (rental active) and owning no oxygen equipment: 20.00.
- A patient who owns a CPAP and whose oxygen rental has reached its payment cap: 10.00, the courtesy being one amount, not two.
- A patient whose CPAP was returned and who has no oxygen record: nothing.
